beats.event: Bored Alice spots a White Rabbit with a pocket watch
Follows the Rabbit down the hole into a long fall
Drinks 'Drink me' and shrinks in the room of doors
Eats 'Eat me' cake and grows enormous, then cries
Shrinks and swims in a pool of her own tears
Joins animals in the absurd Caucus Race
Rabbit mistakes her for maid; sends her for gloves
Grows huge in Rabbit's house, gets stuck, escapes
Caterpillar on mushroom explains size-changing sides
Visits Duchess; baby transforms into a piglet
Endless tea party with Hatter, March Hare, Dormouse
Queen's croquet: flamingos as mallets, hedgehogs as balls
Attends trial of the Knave for stealing tarts
Alice grows in size and defies the court's logic
Dismisses the guards as merely playing cards
Wakes with her sister; runs off for tea
